notes.title: 🥐 Inugami Korone is here! 🥐
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627083/20e3fb3b90fa0e0edd3db66eb258fc4b0eaa19ca.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello! ːkorone_doggoː[/p][p]This update brings a handful of fixes, balance tweaks, and a few highly requested quality-of-life improvements. Thanks to everyone in the community for all the reports, suggestions and for beta testing![/p][p][/p][h2]New Content:[/h2][p][b]Inugami Korone[/b] has been added as a playable character! ːkoroneː[/p][p]Gather the power of the Stars, with our new tab: [b]Holoscope[/b]. [/p][p]Unlock new potential collab combos with [b]Daily Missions[/b]![/p][p]9 new cards have been added![/p][p]60+ new community-made chats are now live! Huge thanks to everyone who contributed![/p][p][/p][h2]Changes & Improvements:[/h2][p]Increased the maximum number of active collabs from 6 to 8. [b]More combos, more power.[/b][/p][p]Collab Filters now include a Search field: [b]you can look up cards by title, group or assets![/b][/p][p]Added a dynamic pricing curve for Unlocks.[/p][p][b]“All In” achievement has been reworded[/b]: now requires purchasing at least one asset upgrade for each asset (was a bit too tricky before).[/p][p]Increased the scaling curve for Encoring.[/p][p]Encoring now always gives you 9 duplicates of the card, not just the number needed to foil it. This should avoid some bad Encore feels.[/p][p]Decreased the number of messages sent at once from 225 to 155 to improve performance.[/p][p]Holocoin Timer [b]no longer resets[/b] on Encore.[/p][p]Holosim idols will no longer crave specific food.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][p]Added a missing Prime Fan upgrade that targets Themed Cafe.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where Prime Fan upgrades wouldn’t work properly with the “Increase % for each 10 Asset” effect.[/p][p]Fixed a rare issue where save files could become corrupted due to time zone differences.[/p][p]Marine’s background in the Collab tab should now display the correct color.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where tier 4 cards would get prioritized after foiling all tier 1s.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the tutorial could randomly appear when hovering around in the Encore screen.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where Week Rewards could shift when Encoring.[/p][p]Centered and enlarged Perrocino’s collab image for consistency.[/p][p]Performance mode should no longer cause text tearing.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support, and we’ll see you in the next one![/p][h2][/h2][h2][/h2][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 + What's Next?
notes.content:
[p]Hello, everyone! The last day was a roller-coaster of emotions, and we saw the birth of a beautiful community that banded together and gave us a lot of insight about the future of Holoidle![/p][p][/p][p]We want to first start with the patch notes for 1.1.0! [b]We are smoothing out the Encore curve.[/b] We still want the idle part of our idle game, but we also feel like Encore could be happening a little more frequently at lower encores. This will also allow us more predictability for future updates (more on that later), and a less reliance on good collabs. We also bring in a few QOL changes that should help keep track of your stream![/p][p][/p][h1]Patch Notes:[/h1][list][*][p]Smoothed out the [b]Encore Curve[/b], meaning you will reach Encore much faster![/p][/*][*][p]Set [b]IpS Bonus[/b] gained when you Encore to a curve instead of a fixed 100% value.[/p][/*][*][p]You can [b]no longer gain duplicates[/b] of Foil cards when you still have cards to unlock.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the capability to [b]click a Trash to clean it[/b]. You can still sweep it clean if you want.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Encore threshold indicator when hovering your Stream Panel (bottom panel).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627083/c95627910d4a14d6e38c9abc8f5d0ae007f5c775.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]Smol Nene[/b] card's value to intended values.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an arrow icon to Collab Cards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627083/5b9f1fc646850a820e32cfd06f49e93d504ea4be.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Created a screen effect to showcase your chat [b]insatisfaction[/b] when you aren't in the correct Activity.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]What's Next:[/h1][p]
We hear all the feedback, and we are working on a new system to let you reach even greater heights and increase decision-making! This system also utilizes duplicates, so your dupes will be worth a lot.[/p][p]While we did smooth out the Encore curve, there is still a limit to how far you can get. This new system is supposed to increase your influence gathering power as well![/p][p]This will still take some time to develop and test, but be sure we are working hard at it. Holoidle is a passion project that is very dear to us, so we want to give you the best experience possible![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - v.1.0.6R
notes.content: [p]Day one and we already got some bug fixes! Thanks to the amazing work done by the community by reporting bugs in our Discord and on Twitter/X, we were able to solve a bunch of issues!![/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a major issue where 4 cards: [b]Bazo[/b], [b]Smol Baelz[/b], [b]Cecilia Immergreen[/b] and [b]Spelling Bee[/b] were [b]unobtainable[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]All kitchen appliances are now [b]Buildable[/b], as intended, so you can now use your hard earned furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a mistake with the [b]Card Enthusiast[/b], [b]Card Collector[/b] and [b]Card Specialist[/b] achievements where it would count all owned cards, including duplicates, resulting in getting the achievement earlier than expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you couldn't change your selected Idol if it was your first time opening the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added fail-safes to try and prevent loading corrupted/broken save files.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where opening the cookbook and leaving it open would prevent clicking anywhere else in other tabs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with [b]Smol Pekora[/b]'s collab card, where the bonus should be [b]ADD[/b] instead of [b]MULTIPLY[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with [b]Sukonbu[/b]'s collab card, where it would affect [b]THEME PARK[/b] unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed [b]Sweeping[/b] logic, which should make cleaning trashes more reliable.[/p][/*][/list]
